i0: **Time conjunctions** join two actions and show **when** they happen: *I had dinner **when** I got home. **While** I was cooking, the phone rang. Wash your hands **before** you eat.*
i1: This page is about time linkers in general and in the past. For the rule *when I **get** home* (present for the future), see [Future Time Clauses](/blog/grammar/future-time-clauses/).
tcj-when-while.s: ***When*** = at that time. ***While*** = during a longer action (often with the past continuous). ***Before*** and ***after*** show the order. The time clause can go **first** (with a comma) or **second**.
tcj-when-while.b0.0.1: ***When** I got home, I made dinner.*
tcj-when-while.b0.1.1: *The phone rang **while** I was having a shower.*
tcj-when-while.b0.2.1: *Brush your teeth **before** you go to bed.*
tcj-when-while.b0.3.1: ***After** we finished lunch, we went for a walk.*
tcj-when-while.b1: When the time clause comes **first**, put a **comma** after it: ***When** the film ended**,** we went home.* No comma when it comes second: *We went home **when** the film ended.*
tcj-when-while.b2: ***Before*** and ***after*** can also take ***-ing***: ***Before leaving**, turn off the lights. **After finishing** work, I went to the gym.*
tcj-until-since.t: As soon as, until, since, once, by the time
tcj-until-since.s: ***As soon as*** = immediately after. ***Until*** = up to that time. ***Since*** = from that time to now (with the present perfect). ***Once*** = after (when something is finished). ***By the time*** = before or at the moment that.
tcj-until-since.b0.0.1: *I called you **as soon as** I heard the news.*
tcj-until-since.b0.3.1: ***Once** you've paid, you'll get a receipt.*
tcj-until-since.b0.4.1: ***By the time** we arrived, the film had started.*
tcj-until-since.b1: After ***since***, use a past time (*since 2019*, *since I left school*); the main clause is usually in the **present perfect**: *I**'ve known** him **since** we were children.*
tcj-sequencing.t: First, then, after that, finally, in the end, at last
tcj-sequencing.s: To tell a story or give instructions in order: ***first***, ***then / next / after that***, ***finally***. ***In the end*** = after a long time or many changes. ***At last*** = after waiting a long time (relief). ***Eventually*** = after a long time.
tcj-sequencing.b0.1.2: ***Then** add the onions. **After that**, add the rice.*
tcj-sequencing.b0.3.1: the final result after problems or changes
tcj-sequencing.b0.3.2: *We looked at ten flats. **In the end**, we chose the first one.*
tcj-sequencing.b1: Don't confuse ***in the end*** (finally) with ***at the end of*** (the last part of something): ***At the end of** the film, everyone cried.*
tcj-sequencing.w0: the last part: at the end of
x.tcj-sequencing-s03: The last part: *at the end of*.
